description: This file contains various utility functions related to health checking and monitoring of a Kubernetes-based environment, including functions for logging setup, fetching kubeconfig from Vault, creating k8s API clients, listing nodes and pods, collecting logs and metrics, performing connectivity checks, and publishing results to Kafka and Loki.

classes.name: HealthResult
classes.description: Data class representing the overall health report, including site ID, environment, timestamp, nodes, pods, connectivity status, metrics, overall status, and a summary.

methods.name: logging.Logger setup_logging(level: str = "INFO")
methods.description: Initializes and returns a logger configured with the specified log level.

methods.name: str fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault(vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0)
methods.description: Retrieves kubeconfig content from HashiCorp Vault given the address, token, and secret path.

methods.name: Tuple[client.CoreV1Api,client.AppsV1Api] build_k8s_client_from_kubeconfig(kubeconfig_content: str)
methods.description: Creates Kubernetes API clients (CoreV1Api and AppsV1Api) from provided kubeconfig content.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_nodes(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Lists Kubernetes nodes with their labels, allocatable resources, conditions, and readiness status.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_pods(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Lists Pods in a specified namespace with container statuses and labels.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] collect_logs_and_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_bytes: int = 50000)
methods.description: Fetches recent logs from specified pods and parses radio access metrics, identifying anomalies.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] tcp_connectivity_check(host: Optional[str], port: int, timeout: float)
methods.description: Performs a TCP connection check to a specified host and port, measuring latency.

methods.name: HealthResult build_health_report( site_id: Optional[str], environment: str, nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]], pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any], metrics: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Assembles and returns a structured health report based on nodes, pods, connectivity, and metrics.

methods.name: None send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Sends a health report payload to a Kafka topic using the provided bootstrap servers.

methods.name: None push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Pushes logs or entries to Loki via HTTP API, with optional tenant ID and labels.
